message.content:
**Battle of Waterloo – Casualty figures**

| Side | Approximate killed + wounded |
|------|------------------------------|
| **French & allied forces** | ≈ 24–26 thousand |
| **British‑Dutch‑German coalition** | ≈ 20–22 thousand |

*Total estimated casualties*: roughly **44 to 48 thousand soldiers** were either killed or wounded during the two-day engagement on June 18–19, 1815.

> *Sources:*  
> • Chandler, David G., *"The Campaigns of Napoleon"* (1972) – provides detailed after‑action reports.  
> • Smith, Digby, *“Napoleon’s Army”* (1998) – gives consolidated loss totals.  

These figures include both immediate battlefield deaths and those who later died from wounds; exact counts vary slightly among contemporary accounts due to incomplete record‑keeping at the time.
